senses.gloss:
गोलः,
 
-ला, -लम् [गुड् अच् डस्य लः] 
__1 A ball, globe; कदम्बगोलाकृतिमाश्रितः कथम् [[Māl. 7. 1.]] 
__2 The celestial or terrestrial globe. 
__3 A circle. 4 A sphere, anything round or globular. 
-लः 
__1 A widow's bastard; cf. कुण्ड; [[Y. 1. 222.]] 
__2 The conjunction of several planets or the presence of several in one sign. 
__3 Myrrh. 
-ला 
__1 A wooden ball with which children play. 
__2 A large globular water-jar. 
__3 Red arsenic. 
__4 Ink. 
__5 A woman's female friend. 
__6 N. of Durgā. 
__7 [Page0675-2] N. of the river Godāvari. 
-Comp. 
-अध्यायः N. of an astronomical work by Bhāskarāchārya. 
-आसनम् ‘ball thrower’, a kind of gun. 
-क्रीडा playing with balls. 
-यन्त्रम् a kind of astronomical instrument.

[गुड् ण्वुल डस्य लः] 
__1 A ball, globe; भूगोलकविशेषं नामरूपमानलक्षणतो व्याख्यास्यामः [[Bhāg. 5. 16. 4.]] 
__2 A wooden ball for playing with. 
__3 A globular water-jar. 
__4 A widow's bastard; परदारेषु जायेते द्वौ सुतौ कुण्डगोलकौ । पत्यौ जीवति कुण्डः स्यान्मृते भर्तरि गोलकः ॥ [[Ms. 3. 174.]] 
__5 A conjunction of six or more planets in one sign. 
__6 Glans penis. 
__7 Molasses. 8 Gum myrrh.
